supersedes.reason: v4 independent review failed because the runner did not enforce review/current gates, input and tool digests were not fully pinned, and release durability and path isolation were incomplete

purpose: Consume at most one candidate-level BLIND join attempt to decide R06 and R07 and freeze one runtime-eligible HF/HMF action-space hash per BLIND circuit, without releasing runtime values, outcomes, paths, run IDs or candidate records.

inputs.post_consumption_rule: The exact six-file measurement digest, complete driver-log digest and driver-log count must match the preregistered job for every circuit before parsing or joining; any mismatch produces a sealed aggregate FAIL.

one_shot_protocol.executed_stage_reference_definition: Every HF/HMF stage-mode reference in 02_hf_coarse, 03_hmf_coarse and 04_integer_refine except contract-defined NOT_RUN. Repeatability NO_RESULT_PATH is outside the formal stages; a pathless formal stage-mode reference is MISSING_RESULT_PATH, remains in the denominator and fails R07.
one_shot_protocol.output_directory_rule: Use only the exact preregistered dedicated output directory. It must be a canonical non-symlink directory that is absent or empty before consumption; CONSUMED, receipt.json, receipt.json.sha256 and RELEASED are distinct fixed paths.
one_shot_protocol.consumption_order: After all local contracts, current assessment, tool hashes, job hashes, aggregate receipts and independent review PASS are verified, create and fsync CONSUMED with O_EXCL before the first BLIND input read.
one_shot_protocol.release_order: Durably publish receipt.json, then its external digest sidecar, then fsync an exclusive RELEASED completion marker. Consumers reject any state missing one artifact or failing the digest check.
one_shot_protocol.crash_rule: Any crash after durable CONSUMED consumes the sole attempt. An incomplete directory without RELEASED is INCOMPLETE_CONSUMED and must never be replayed.
one_shot_protocol.failure_action: After consumption, publish only an outcome-free aggregate FAIL envelope with no per-circuit partial values when possible; never retry.

decision_rules.R06: PASS only when ambiguous_runtime_join_count is zero for every BLIND circuit.
decision_rules.R07: PASS only when missing and ambiguous counts are zero, unique equals the formal denominator, and coverage is 1.0 for every BLIND circuit.
decision_rules.R13: After reseal, bind every preregistered method to the exact same per-circuit action hashes with no method-specific exclusion.
decision_rules.p0: P0 remains BLOCKED until an independent reassessment establishes R01 through R14 all PASS.
